user.title: Add an AIPAI A8 reef light
user.description: Enter the light's IP address on your network (for example {example}). Give the light a DHCP reservation in your router so it doesn't change.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the light. Check the IP address and that it is on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.not_a8: Something answered at that address, but it does not speak the A8 protocol.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This light (same serial number) is already set up.
